# EC P-256 chain for the renewed-issuer tests, all ecdsa-with-SHA256: root_cert (CN=TlsLib Renewal Root, self-signed,
# serial 1) issues issuer_cert (CN=TlsLib Renewal Issuer, CA:TRUE, serial 2, valid 2020-01-01..2099-12-31) and
# issuer_old_cert (the same subject and the same key, serial 3, valid 2020-01-01..2021-01-01, the expired copy of the
# renewal). leaf_cert (serial 4, CN/SAN=localhost, EKU serverAuth+clientAuth, valid 2020-01-01..2099-12-31) is issued by
# the issuer key, so it chains through either copy; leaf_key is its PKCS#8 key.
# Generated with OpenSSL 3.2.1 (openssl ca -batch -startdate/-enddate; one issuer.key and one issuer.csr signed twice):
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out X.key   (root, issuer, leaf)
#   openssl req -new -key X.key -subj "/CN=<name>" -out X.csr
#   openssl ca -config ca.cnf -selfsign -in root.csr -keyfile root.key -startdate 20200101000000Z -enddate 20991231000000Z -extfile ca.ext
#   openssl ca -config ca.cnf -in issuer.csr -cert root.pem -keyfile root.key -startdate 20200101000000Z -enddate 20991231000000Z -extfile ca.ext   (issuer_cert)
#   openssl ca -config ca.cnf -in issuer.csr -cert root.pem -keyfile root.key -startdate 20200101000000Z -enddate 20210101000000Z -extfile ca.ext   (issuer_old_cert)
#   openssl ca -config ca.cnf -in leaf.csr -cert issuer.pem -keyfile issuer.key -startdate 20200101000000Z -enddate 20991231000000Z -extfile leaf.ext
#     ca.ext: basicConstraints=critical,CA:true / keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign / subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#     leaf.ext: basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth,clientAuth / subjectAltName=DNS:localhost / subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#   openssl verify -CAfile root.pem -untrusted issuer.pem leaf.pem   (OK);  openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -nocrypt -outform DER (leaf_key);  openssl x509 -outform DER | hex (the rest)
